title: Cancel closes the part window without saving
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with description 1 and a Sell Price of $20.00.
  • Use a different description, description 2.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Description with description 2.
  4. Replace the Sell Price with 99.00.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed with description 1.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Description shows description 2.

Step 4:

  • Sell Price shows 99.00.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the part A row still shows description 1.

Step 6:

  • The fields read description 1 and Sell Price 20.00: nothing was saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R8: “Cancel is the design system's secondary button: white, with a grey outline and dark label. It closes the dialog without saving.”
